primary_outcome: the statements printed by /app/tools/commission_run.py give every rep's bookings, commission, bonus, clawback, total, recovered, owed, paid and carried amounts as the Field Sales Compensation Plan issue 6 gives them

obligations.contribution: bookings add the rep's split share of each order that counts toward the rep's quarter

authority.anchor: A rep's share of an amount is the rep's split, in per cent, of that amount.

obligations.discriminating_instance: orders with splits of 1 to 99 per cent, and split shares landing on half a cent

obligations.contribution: commission is 800 bp of bookings up to the quota, 1,200 bp of the part to twice the quota and 1,600 bp above, each band rounded half up

authority.anchor: Commission is earned on bookings in three bands.

obligations.discriminating_instance: bookings exactly on the quota and on twice the quota, between, and far above; band remainders of half a cent or more
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: the reached band's rate on all bookings (shipped); truncation (shipped)

obligations.contribution: a reversal claws back 800 bp of the rep's share up to an age of 120 days and nothing after; a credit note that is not a reversal keeps today's line (silent, kept)

authority.anchor: The clawback window of a reversal is 120 days.

obligations.discriminating_instance: reversals aged 91 to 121 days; credit notes below 50,000 cents aged 0 to 90, 91 to 120 and above
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: editing the shared window_days entry to 120 (natural fix of 5.1); nothing for credit notes that are not reversals; no age limit for them

obligations.contribution: a new-logo order earns 300 bp of the rep's share with no floor; a first order that is not new-logo keeps today's line (silent, kept)

authority.anchor: A new-logo order that counts toward the rep's quarter earns a bonus of 300

obligations.discriminating_instance: new-logo orders with rep shares below 10,000 cents; first orders below 250,000 cents with rep shares below 10,000, 10,000 to 24,999 and above
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: editing the shared small_cents entry to 25,000 (natural fix of 7.4); nothing for first orders that are not new-logo; the floor removed for every first order
obligations.selfdescription_phrase: a first order that is not a new-logo order

obligations.contribution: the draw is paid when the total falls short and the shortfall is owed; the owed balance is recovered only from the part of the total above the draw

authority.anchor: Otherwise the owed balance is recovered from the part of the total above

obligations.discriminating_instance: reps with a draw whose owed balance exceeds the total's excess over the draw; totals exactly on the draw and below nought
obligations.selfdescription_phrase: recovered only from the part of the total above the draw

obligations.contribution: a draw-less rep's due of 25,000 cents or more is paid, a smaller due carried

authority.anchor: nought is paid a due of 25,000 cents or more in full; a smaller due is not paid

obligations.discriminating_instance: dues of 10,000 to 24,999 cents, exactly 25,000, and below 10,000
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: 10,000 cents (shipped small_cents, shared with the bonus floor)
obligations.selfdescription_phrase: minimum payment reads a new payment_cents figure

obligations.contribution: the fixed driver prints the statements as JSON

universal_rule.anchor: Each rule of the plan holds for every job inside the limits of its section 1

silence.anchor: Change only what the plan decides.
